email_subject: Application - Full-Stack Developer / Shopify Expert (eCommerce CRO Focus)
email_body:
Hi,

I'm applying for the Full-Stack Developer / Shopify Expert role. I'm based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, and I work where front-end code, Shopify storefronts and conversion-focused SEO meet.

My Shopify work has been hands-on: store design, building and maintaining the product catalogue, and publishing content for harwindtf.com and custompremiumshirt.com. Before that I was a front-end developer at ViviDoctor, building and optimizing features in AngularJS and JavaScript for a healthcare web application. Day to day I work in HTML, CSS, JavaScript and Python, run technical audits, and read Google Analytics and Search Console to decide what to change next.

I won't claim years of A/B testing at high-traffic scale that I don't have. What I bring is clean front-end work, technical curiosity, and the habit of checking whether a change actually helped. I'd like to do that on storefronts where it shows up in the numbers.

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm applying for the Full-Stack Developer / Shopify Expert role with a CRO focus. I'm based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, and my work sits on the seam this role describes: front-end code, Shopify storefronts, and the measurement that tells you whether a change was worth making.

On Shopify, I've worked on harwindtf.com and custompremiumshirt.com - store design, building and maintaining the product catalogue, and writing and publishing blog content. Earlier, as a front-end developer at ViviDoctor, I built and optimized features in AngularJS and JavaScript for a healthcare web application. Since then I've kept shipping: a hand-coded landing page with a WebGL hero on baverok.com including accessible markup and structured data, and multi-page builds in WordPress and Elementor where I handle structure, content and technical SEO end to end.

The optimization side interests me as much as the development side. I run technical audits, read Google Analytics and Search Console, and use Semrush, Ahrefs and structured data to find where a page underperforms. On mirook.com, iterative technical and GEO audits measurably raised the site's search-health score. I write Python to automate repetitive work, use AI tools daily, and have an Android app live on Google Play.

What I'll be honest about: my Shopify experience is hands-on storefront, catalogue and content work rather than years of Liquid at high-traffic scale, and I haven't yet run large A/B testing programmes. Those are exactly the things I want to build next, on storefronts where the numbers matter. I'm methodical, I document what I do, and I care about clean code and honest reporting of results.

I'd welcome the chance to talk about how I could contribute.

Sincerely,
